source_contract: Bind the permanent particle domain and borrow its context before the raw allocation attempt.
Use the captured allocation as the constructor receiver; ignore its returned value.
Mark construction failed before freeing the captured allocation on a thrown constructor; preserve original partial publication and registry effects.
Retire construction before the first successful construction log and locale allocation.
Reject re-entry after the first attempt. Guard constructing or failed phases before four destructive shutdown paths; Source policy exits without cleanup.
